topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: This morning, a delivery was left at my doorstep, neatly packaged and marked with a name that didn’t belong to me. It was clear the courier had mistaken my address for the previous tenant’s. I took a moment to examine the package, noting the careful tape and the address label, slightly weathered but still legible. I decided to open my laptop and find a way to contact the sender to inform them of the mix-up. As I waited for the website to load, I placed the package on the kitchen counter, making a mental note to keep it safe until it could be redirected. It’s a simple task, really, but one that felt necessary and considerate.
